name: Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
benefit: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to socially and economically backward class students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Economically Weaker Section category. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicant’s individual and family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum.
